description: Implementation of QuicUnackedPacketMap class managing unacknowledged packets in QUIC protocol, including packet tracking, retransmission, and frame acknowledgment logic.

classes.name: QuicUnackedPacketMap
classes.description: Manages the set of unacknowledged packets in a QUIC connection, tracking their state, handling retransmissions, and providing packet and frame status.

methods.name: AddSentPacket
methods.description: Records a sent packet, updating internal state and possibly marking it as in-flight.

methods.name: RemoveObsoletePackets
methods.description: Removes packets that are no longer useful for RTT measurement or retransmission.

methods.name: HasRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet or transmission info has retransmittable frames.

methods.name: RemoveRetransmittability
methods.description: Removes retransmittable frames from a packet or transmission info.

methods.name: IncreaseLargestAcked
methods.description: Updates the largest acknowledged packet number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateLargestAckedOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Updates the largest acknowledged packet number for a specific packet number space.

methods.name: IsPacketUsefulForMeasuringRtt
methods.description: Determines if a packet is useful for RTT measurement.

methods.name: IsPacketUsefulForCongestionControl
methods.description: Checks if a packet contributes to congestion control.

methods.name: IsPacketUsefulForRetransmittableData
methods.description: Checks if a packet is useful for retransmission.

methods.name: IsPacketUseless
methods.description: Determines if a packet is no longer useful for RTT, congestion, or retransmission.

methods.name: IsUnacked
methods.description: Checks if a packet is currently unacknowledged.

methods.name: RemoveFromInFlight
methods.description: Removes a packet or transmission info from the in-flight set.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedPackets
methods.description: Marks unencrypted packets as neutered after encryption upgrade.

methods.name: NeuterHandshakePackets
methods.description: Marks handshake packets as neutered.

methods.name: HasInFlightPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are any packets currently in flight.

methods.name: GetTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves transmission info for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetMutableTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves mutable transmission info for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetLastInFlightPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the last in-flight packet was sent.

methods.name: GetLastCryptoPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the last crypto packet was sent.

methods.name: GetNumUnackedPacketsDebugOnly
methods.description: Returns the count of unacknowledged packets for debugging.

methods.name: HasMultipleInFlightPackets
methods.description: Checks if multiple packets are currently in flight.

methods.name: HasPendingCryptoPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are unacked crypto data packets.

methods.name: HasUnackedRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are unacked retransmittable frames.

methods.name: GetLeastUnacked
methods.description: Returns the smallest unacknowledged packet number.

methods.name: SetSessionNotifier
methods.description: Sets the session notifier interface.

methods.name: NotifyFramesAcked
methods.description: Notifies that frames have been acknowledged.

methods.name: NotifyFramesLost
methods.description: Notifies that frames have been lost.

methods.name: RetransmitFrames
methods.description: Requests retransmission of specified frames.

methods.name: MaybeAggregateAckedStreamFrame
methods.description: Attempts to aggregate stream frames that have been acknowledged.

methods.name: NotifyAggregatedStreamFrameAcked
methods.description: Notifies that an aggregated stream frame has been acknowledged.

methods.name: GetPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Determines the packet number space for a given packet or encryption level.

methods.name: GetLargestAckedOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the largest acknowledged packet number in a specific space.

methods.name: GetLastInFlightPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the send time of the last in-flight packet in a specific space.

methods.name: GetLargestSentRetransmittableOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the largest sent retransmittable packet in a space.

methods.name: GetFirstInFlightTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Returns the first in-flight transmission info.

methods.name: GetFirstInFlightTransmissionInfoOfSpace
methods.description: Returns the first in-flight transmission info in a specific space.

methods.name: EnableMultiplePacketNumberSpacesSupport
methods.description: Enables support for multiple packet number spaces.

methods.name: GetLastPacketContent
methods.description: Returns a bitfield representing the content of the last packet.
